audience: Hackathon judging panel and nontechnical organisers

visuals.style: actual interface captures, restrained camera motion, large explanatory captions
visuals.motion: stable frontal UI, gentle push-in, readable holds; no flashing or shake

scope: Show the actual local app. Rehearsal is explicitly scripted; real Jev, deterministic guards, persisted local restoration and offline verification are real. No actual payments, external agent/container actuation, signed records or certified compliance are claimed.
data: Use only the prototype's synthetic sample tickets. Never show API keys, raw database connection strings, environment files or private terminal data.
implementation: Use inspected local FFmpeg skill scripts and genuine page captures. No generated imitation of the app UI. Abstract opening/closing cards are original graphics.

shots.heading: When good ratings weaken good rules
shots.narration: An AI refund assistant can learn the wrong lesson: chase good ratings, and quietly weaken the refund rules.

shots.heading: SAAF Circuit Breaker
shots.narration: We built SAAF Circuit Breaker: a safety layer outside the assistant, so suggestions cannot override business limits.

shots.heading: 1 · Forge: inspect the setup
shots.narration: Forge inspects the agent and produces a risk report and rule files.

shots.heading: 2 · Rehearsal: practice under pressure
shots.narration: Rehearsal plays thirty-six sample tickets. With protection off, the scripted scenario shows rules eroding and unauthorized refunds.

shots.heading: Protection on: contain the violations
shots.narration: Switch protection on, and the same scenario shows the guard containing those violations.

shots.heading: 3 · Sentinel: guard the proposed action
shots.narration: Now a live test: twenty-one euros thirty-five, no photo. The hard guard blocks it. Real Jev checks the instructions and saved lessons.

shots.heading: Reject unsafe state. Restore safe instructions.
shots.narration: When unsafe rules are detected, the local runtime restores safe instructions and memory, and saves the decision for human review.

shots.heading: 4 · Verify: recheck the decision receipt
shots.narration: Verify rechecks the saved decision and rules without another model call. Change the recorded verdict, and the consistency check fails.

shots.heading: Let the AI propose. Keep policy in charge.
shots.narration: This is a working local prototype: real Jev and containment, scripted rehearsal, and no real payments. Let the AI propose. Keep policy in charge.
